title: Serve G1 Cache on Both Interfaces
description: Make both Ethernet and Wi-Fi usable for g1 NFS and cache
summary: Enabled server Wi-Fi. NFS answers on Ethernet and Wi-Fi. Cache listens on both fleet IPs through one authenticated service, and both published endpoints return HTTP 200.
